HxResult HxArrayAppend ( HxArray_t *  pArray,
void *  pElement 
)

Append an element ot the array.

This function will append an element to the array. The element is appended to the end of the array.

Parameters:
array IN: Valid dynamic array
pElement IN: Array element
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxArrayDelete ( HxArray_t **  array  ) 

Delete a dynamic array.

This function deletes a dynamic array including the memory. Any elements in the array that allocated its memory should be deleted by the application itself.

Parameters:
array IN: Valid dynamic array
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxArrayNew ( int  numElements,
HxArray_t **  array 
)

Create a new dynamic array.

This function creates a new dynamic array with a pre-defined size. It is the responsibility of the application to remove the allocated memory using HxArrayDelete.

Parameters:
numElements IN: Amount of preallocated elements
array OUT: Returns a handle to the new array.
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxArrayRemove ( HxArray_t *  pArray,
void *  pElement 
)

Remove an element from the array.

This function will remove an element from the array. It is the responsibility of the application to delete any memory allocated for the element itself.

Parameters:
array IN: Valid dynamic array
pElement IN: Array element
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
